preconditions.description: The number of elements n must be between 1 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a[i] <= 100000 for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each element a_i must be between 1 and 100000.
The length of the sequence a must be equal to n.

postconditions.description: The output string must have a length equal to n.

postconditions.expression: all(c in '123' for c in stdout)
postconditions.description: Each character in the output string must be either '1', '2', or '3'.
The output string must correctly categorize each index i into groups 1, 2, or 3 based on the longest increasing subsequences.
